contexts.text: Like the vapour from hogs scraped in a trough. SE 1292, SE 1294.

She emptied her pitcher into the trough () = the separation of the affection of truth which was being initiated into Divine good... A trough = the good of truth; for the water in the trough = truth; and the trough itself, the same as wood, namely, good.
He set the rods... in the gutters () = further preparation... The glitters = the good of truth in the Natural. AC 4030.

They filled the troughs () = enriched the doctrine of charity... The reason a trough = the doctrine of charity, is that it is a wooden trough, into which water is drawn from a well for flocks to drink.
On those who constitute the province of the duct of the hepatic gall.
Filthy water was seen to flow out of a certain gutter.
